render_object_constructor: render an object in constructor format like Foo(bar=1, baz=2) for treescope display
render_dictionary_wrapper: render an object in wrapped dictionary format like Foo({"bar": 1}) for treescope display
render_list_wrapper: render an object in wrapped list format like Foo([1, 2, 3]) for treescope display
render_enumlike_item: render an enum-like value with name and value annotation for treescope display
handle_custom_mapping: register a handler for custom mapping types in the treescope type registry
